replies.author: Zeusy
replies.body:
Hello,

After going reviewing your infractions, we've come to the conclusion to deny your appeal. You currently have 29 valid infractions, most of which are excessive. You have broken too many rules, and have shown that you clearly do not learn from these punishments, thus a permanent ban is indeed required. My apologies for the confusion earlier.

Best Regards, 
Zeusy, 
Avicus Senior Moderator
